rejected_rule.statement: A co-owner cannot acquire prescriptive title to a co-owned land without the other co-owners being ousted from common usage of the land.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: A co-owner’s possession is, in law, the possession of his co-owners. It is not possible for him to put an end to that possession by any secret intention in his mind. Nothing short of ouster or something equivalent to ouster could bring about that result.
